name: notion-knowledge-capture
title_zh: 聊完天自动把结论归档成 Notion 知识页
tagline_zh: 会议聊完、讨论出结论，不用再手动整理。它把对话里的决策、洞见、待办挑出来，按你的 wiki 结构排版、加链接。
tagline_en: Stop copy-pasting chat notes into Notion. It extracts decisions, insights, and action items, formats them for.
desc_en: Transforms conversations and discussions into structured documentation pages in Notion. Captures insights, decisions, and knowledge from chat context, formats appropriately, and saves to wikis or databases with proper organization and linking for easy discovery.
why_zh: 不是把聊天记录整段丢进去，而是先识别「哪句话是结论、哪句是背景」。
why_en: It doesn't dump raw chat logs. It separates conclusions from context, then builds parent-child pages with backlinks, so.
limit_zh: 只处理当前对话上下文，不扫描历史记录；需要你有 Notion 集成权限和已建好的数据库或 wiki 结构。
limit_en: Only works on current chat context, not past logs. Requires Notion integration access and an existing database/wiki structure. Output is.
title_en: Turn chat conclusions into structured Notion pages
